headline: Fonterra Seeks Regulatory Approval to Dispose of Excess Raw Milk
summary: New Zealand dairy giant Fonterra requested environmental permission to dispose of millions of liters of raw milk due to processing capacity constraints during seasonal surplus production.
why: Fonterra Co-operative Group is the world's largest dairy exporter, processing bulk milk output from New Zealand farmers into global commodities.

impacts.name: Fonterra
impacts.why: Wasting raw milk due to bottlenecks creates direct inventory losses.
